about: Difficulty-ladder audit, Nov 12 2026. Each entry reorders one category's five clues so they climb; values stay on their rows and no clue text changes. 'order' lists the old row numbers in their new order. Found by reading 346 categories in full: 246 that a data check flagged (answers getting more familiar as the value rose) and 100 picked at random.

fixes.name: DECKED OUT
fixes.why: The China clue names the Tang dynasty, so it was the easiest clue sitting on the top value.

fixes.name: SEA THE WORLD
fixes.why: 'This ocean' is a one-in-four guess; the Coral Sea two-step is the hardest.
fixes.done: a rip current (riptide)|the equator|the Pacific (South Pacific)|the Gulf Stream|the Coral Sea

fixes.name: MEDIEVAL TIMES
fixes.why: The Black Death is easier than a knight's squire.
fixes.done: the Black Death|Magna Carta|a squire|the Crusades|Hastings (the Battle of Hastings)

fixes.name: TEE-RIFFIC
fixes.why: The albatross clue hands over 'rare seabird'; the oldest major is harder.
fixes.done: a mulligan|the green jacket|the Moon|an albatross (double eagle)|the Open Championship (British Open)

fixes.name: DEVELOPING STORY
fixes.why: Child labor and Life magazine are the easy ones; Mathew Brady was too hard to open on.

fixes.name: DIAMOND MINDS
fixes.why: A walk-off homer is everyday baseball talk; 'a can of corn' is the deep cut.

fixes.name: JAPANESE MASTERS
fixes.why: Three daughters and a Shakespeare tragedy give King Lear away; Ozu is the hard one.

fixes.name: THE TRANSLATORS
fixes.why: The top clue named 'One Hundred Years of Solitude', so its author was a gift.
fixes.done: the King James Version|Gabriel Garcia Marquez|Omar Khayyam|the Vulgate|seventy

fixes.name: SURROUNDED!
fixes.why: Ceuta and Melilla belonging to Spain is easier than Lesotho's low point or Kaliningrad.

fixes.name: CROWNS OF AFRICA
fixes.why: Ras Tafari and the Rastafarians make Haile Selassie the opener; Mansa Musa sits mid-board.

fixes.name: CONSTITUTIONAL NUMBERS
fixes.why: Two terms is the easiest answer on the board and sat on the second-highest value.
fixes.done: the First (First Amendment)|two|the 19th (19th Amendment)|the 18th (18th Amendment)|the 27th (27th Amendment)

fixes.name: WHITE COAT WONDERS
fixes.why: Darwin and the Beagle is easier than Salk testing his vaccine at home.
fixes.done: Isaac Newton|Charles Darwin|Jonas Salk|Benjamin Spock (Dr. Spock)|Galileo

fixes.name: LIFTOFF!
fixes.why: John Glenn's return to space is easier than Laika or Gagarin's shout.
